instruction: Cinematic still, low-angle medium close-up. In a dark indoor studio, the woman in the yellow long-sleeve shirt (R2) on the left tilts her head completely back, looking straight up with arms raised. Next to her, the man in the rust-brown long-sleeve shirt (R3) also tilts his head back, reaching his arm diagonally upward. In the background, several other hands and arms from unseen dancers reach toward the ceiling. Soft overhead light illuminates their faces and warm-toned shirts against the dark background.
elements: R2 is the dancer tilting her head completely back and looking straight up with arms raised
R3 is the dancer next to R2 who tilts his head back while reaching an arm diagonally upward
R2 and R3 are both participating in an upward-reaching dance pose
Background dancers' hands and arms reach toward the ceiling
The scene is set in a dark indoor studio with soft overhead lighting

questions.element: R2 has the fully head-back, straight-up-looking raised-arms duty
